other.text: Run review, description, and Q&A commands in a pull request. Its local Git provider also compares a checked-out commit with a target branch.

mortis.text: You want to review exactly what is staged before committing, then use the same engine from Python to inspect findings and coverage. Mortis can also review every eligible tracked file at a release commit.

other.text: Kody Rules apply team policy across repositories. Kody Issues tracks suggestions after a PR closes, and the CLI can review the staged diff.

mortis.text: You need an inspectable decision for a particular release. Use a saved review ID to verify a finding against the release commit, keep the original evidence, and export the report without another model call.

other.text: OCR exports SARIF and compares findings across saved sessions. With a review manifest it distinguishes an unmatched finding in a reviewed file from one in a file the later run never examined.

mortis.text: You need to answer why a specific issue is fixed. Give Mortis the earlier review ID and the new Git ref. Its verifier checks the cited code from both revisions before accepting that verdict.

other.text: Qodo provides cross-repository context. Its published local-review workflow sends the diff and coding-session context to Qodo and requires the comparison base on the remote.

mortis.text: Your base and head exist only in a local clone, or your application needs to supply its own AI provider credentials. Mortis resolves both revisions locally, sends eligible source to the selected provider, and returns a versioned Python dictionary.
